note: Per-episode decision objects (AutonomyDecision/AgentAutonomyDecision) are not separately dumped to disk for this run to keep artifact size bounded -- every evaluation script in scripts/run_phase4_*.py is fully deterministic given its documented seed ranges, so any decision record can be reproduced exactly by re-running the relevant script (see each report's reproducibility section). Aggregated decision-outcome breakdowns (decision distribution, retry rate, review rate, abstention rate) ARE persisted per-condition in evaluation/retry_metrics.json and evaluation/ablation_results.json.
